svg.title: A code editor typing short excerpts from my repositories: padachar's daily step goal (Kotlin), anukalpa's medicine strength matching (JavaScript), padachar's step counter maths (Kotlin).

text.tspan: * Steps against the daily goal, for Home, the widget, the charts and the goal notice.
* Unlike [DayRings], nothing stops at 100%, so walking past the goal still shows.

g.text: fun reached(steps: Long, goal: Int): Boolean = goal > 0 && steps >= goal

text.tspan: /** "+1,240 over your goal", "Right on your goal", or "" before the goal is reached. */

g.text: fun overText(steps: Long, goal: Int, locale: Locale = Locale.getDefault()): String =
else -> String.format(locale, "+%,d over your goal", steps - goal)
